sources.title: Manage usage credits for paid Claude plans

folds.title: Your allowance
points: Claude has a usage allowance, not a fixed number of messages.
What you get depends on your plan.

folds.title: One shared allowance
points: Shared across web, desktop, mobile and Claude Code.
See how much you have used in your settings.

folds.title: What uses more
points: Tools like research, web search and file creation.

folds.title: The long chat
points: You have a 60-message chat about a holiday.
Now you ask about your car in the same chat.
Claude carries all 60 messages along with that question.
folds.note: In a fresh chat, it reads just one.

folds.title: Save usage
items: Start a new chat for a new topic.
Put related questions into one clear message.
Pick a lighter model for simple jobs.
Use a project for documents you reuse.
Be specific, so Claude needs fewer follow-ups.

folds.question: You have a new, unrelated question. Which habit saves more usage?
options: Keep going in your long old chat
Ask three small questions in a row
folds.why: Claude keeps the whole earlier chat in view, so a long chat costs more. A fresh chat starts light.
